Silky chocolate ganache paired with delicate poached pear

## The Concept

A dessert built around the contrast between rich chocolate and the delicate sweetness of poached pear.

The composition combines a smooth ganache with the soft texture and subtle fruit character of pear, creating a dessert that is indulgent without becoming overly heavy.

## Composition

The flexible ganache forms the rich centre of the dessert, providing a deep chocolate character and smooth mouthfeel.

Poached pear introduces freshness and natural sweetness, creating a complementary fruit element within the composition.

## Technique

The ganache is prepared to achieve a smooth and flexible texture suitable for controlled plating and clean presentation.

The pear is carefully prepared to retain its delicate texture while absorbing the flavours of the poaching process.

## Presentation

The dessert uses the contrast of dark chocolate and pale pear to create a refined visual composition with a focus on texture and simplicity.

Espresso-soaked ladyfinger, mascarpone air and cocoa tuile

## The Concept

A contemporary interpretation of the classic tiramisu, separating its familiar elements and rebuilding them as an individual plated dessert.

The dish preserves the identity of tiramisu while presenting its flavours and textures through a more modern visual language.

## Composition

Espresso-soaked ladyfinger provides the familiar coffee character, while mascarpone brings richness and softness.

A delicate cocoa tuile introduces a crisp textural contrast and reinforces the chocolate and cocoa notes associated with the classic dessert.

## Technique

The dessert relies on precise preparation of each individual component before being assembled on the plate.

The balance between creamy, soft, crisp, and coffee-infused elements is central to the final composition.

## Presentation

The components are intentionally separated and arranged with precision, allowing the guest to experience the familiar flavours of tiramisu through a contemporary presentation.

Petite laminated croissant focused on precision, consistency and classic viennoiserie technique

The Mini Croissant focuses on the precision required to translate classic croissant technique into a smaller format.

Working at a reduced scale makes consistency particularly important, from lamination and shaping through to proofing and baking.

## Technique

The process follows the essential principles of traditional laminated viennoiserie.

Careful control of dough temperature, butter distribution, lamination, shaping, and proofing helps preserve the characteristic layered structure at a smaller size.

## Texture

The finished pastry aims to retain the essential qualities of a classic croissant — a delicate exterior, defined layers, and a light interior.

## Presentation

The smaller format makes the pastry suitable for breakfast service, buffets, afternoon tea, and composed pastry presentations.

## The Concept

Vada Pav Croissant is a contemporary interpretation of Mumbai's iconic street-food combination through the language of French viennoiserie.

The concept brings together a familiar local inspiration with the laminated structure and presentation of a croissant.

## Inspiration

The idea is rooted in the contrast between traditional Indian street-food flavours and classical pastry technique.

The result is intended to feel recognisable while presenting the inspiration in an unexpected form.

## Technique

The croissant begins with the fundamental principles of laminated dough — controlled fermentation, precise butter incorporation, careful lamination, and consistent shaping.

The final product requires attention to proofing and baking to achieve the characteristic layered structure of a well-made croissant.

## Presentation

The finished croissant combines the visual identity of classic viennoiserie with an unmistakably local inspiration.
